FAILURE.meaning: Nonfinite or out-of-range outputs fail; no clipping or model fallback.

MOVE_TO_HOLD.meaning: finite Stage2 result realizes current tick; next context STATIC

MOVE_TO_MOVE.meaning: finite projected tick differs; next context MOVE

STATIC_TO_HOLD.meaning: delta zero; projected=current; next latest delta zero

STATIC_TO_MOVE.meaning: Current integer tick is copied and no Stage2 call is made. Malformed input, corruption and execution failure are outside successful branch semantics.

stages.contract: P=2L+3: intercept, L delayed commands u[k-d-L+1..k-d], L prior tick increments through tick[k]-tick[k-1], current tick[k], speed[k]. One-step target tick[k+1] is not a feature. Existing history/termination negative labels already exist.
stages.name: Observed feature history

stages.contract: Raw x[:, -3] != 0 selects MOVE head; equality selects STATIC head. Routing precedes normalization. STATIC basis removes only the latest prior-delta structural column; MOVE keeps all V1 effective columns. These conditioned binary heads can encode onset/hold and continuation/stop outcomes; no separate four-class output is implemented.
stages.name: Context and head routing

stages.contract: Each head applies the same V1 TRAIN normalizer, its own retained-basis linear score and sigmoid. Combined original-order TRAIN scores used one global threshold with exact BA_NUM/TN/threshold tie order. Existing decision remains frozen; its private value is neither read nor copied.
stages.name: Score and frozen TRAIN decision

stages.contract: MOVE iff score > frozen TRAIN decision; equality is STATIC. Validated callers supply integer current ticks. Integrated output initializes delta=0 and projected=current; only gated rows invoke Stage2 and projection. STATIC cannot move on a successful frozen caller path.
stages.name: Gate and HOLD branch

stages.contract: Unchanged V1 Stage2 was OLS on TRAIN true-MOVE rows with its own frozen normalizer. predict_delta transforms the same feature vector then applies its linear model. Output is finite signed source-grid tick increment; no nonzero constraint or physical-rate integration exists. integrated_delta is gate-conditioned delta, not torque integration.
stages.name: Stage2 continuous signed delta

stages.contract: For gated rows project(current_float64 + delta). np.rint rounds to nearest with ties-to-even; projected values outside signed16 range fail instead of clipping; successful output is int64. A nonzero continuous delta may still realize the current tick. No new deadband or quantization policy is proposed.
stages.name: Tick addition and projection

stages.contract: Projected movement is new-current != 0, not the gate. MOVE→HOLD therefore yields zero next prior delta, while a missed observed MOVE also leaves projected STATIC state. The implementation explicitly permits gate/realization disagreement.
stages.name: Realized movement semantics

stages.contract: Initial L+1 ticks are observed; np.diff gives initial past deltas. Every step builds features from projected current and full delta history, logs context from the latest delta, calls integrated, shifts history and stores new-current. Both Stage1 score inputs and Stage2 inputs change with projected state. Every path/horizon starts fresh; H steps produce H+1 ticks. Final movement influences only a hypothetical next context outside that horizon.
stages.name: Recursive feedback and reset

stages.contract: Anchors enforce full eligible causal history and a continuous horizon within admitted segments. rollout supplies logged delayed command and speed sequences and retrieves future observed ticks only outside recursive for evaluation. This retrospective conditional rollout is not a controller/vehicle closed-loop forecast; observed future tick truth never sets recursive context.
stages.name: Horizon admission and supplied exogenous inputs

stages.contract: One-step RMSE/MAE/p95 use continuous integrated delta minus observed increment; exact-hit/within-one use projected tick versus target. HOLD delta is zero/current tick. Rollout candidate error is terminal projected tick minus terminal observed tick; HOLD keeps initial tick for the whole horizon. PATH_MOVED means any observed departure from initial, including return paths; it is not a physical actuator command.
stages.name: Comparator and error primitives
